aggressive_definition: High-grade prostate cancer; the abstract does not provide a Gleason-score threshold.
aggressive_definition_excerpt: Docosahexaenoic acid was positively associated with high-grade disease
study_design: Nested case-control analysis within the Prostate Cancer Prevention Trial examining 7-year period prevalence by prostate cancer grade.
reason: The abstract explicitly analyzes high-grade prostate cancer and separately reports null findings for low-grade disease. It describes a 7-year period-prevalence nested case-control analysis rather than explicitly establishing a prospective cohort analysis. No high-grade case count or explicit total analytic sample size is reported.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Docosahexaenoic acid was positively associated with high-grade disease (quartile 4 vs. 1: odds ratio (OR) = 2.50, 95% confidence interval (CI): 1.34, 4.65)
estimate_classifications.reason: The estimate explicitly concerns high-grade prostate cancer. Docosahexaenoic acid is the specific omega-3 fatty acid measured; the row should not be interpreted as an estimate for total dietary omega-3 intake.
